sources.quote: Delta Coronae Borealis is a variable star in the constellation of Corona Borealis.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 36 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,292 K, so 7.167 solar radii.

sources.quote: It has the proper name Matrichakra; Delta Coronae Borealis is its Bayer designation, which is Latinized from δ Coronae Borealis and abbreviated Delta CrB or δ CrB.
